Very Pleasant Food at PastaMania
Jan 2021
To be honest, I wasn't expecting much from a non Italian chain but I was so wrong. We had the lunchtime deal which consists of a soup and main course and a soft drink. I chose the Minestrone soup and I can honestly say it was the most delicious Minestrone soup I have ever eaten anywhere - rich, flavorsome and hearty and the perfect garlic bread that came with it would put most garlic bread makers to shame. I generally find in most restaurants in Vietnam, with a few exceptions, the garlic bread is usually rock hard, hardly any butter on it and very little taste of garlic, if at all. However, at PastaMania, the outside edges were just the right crispness, the rest of the bread a perfect mix of crispy underside and a soft topside saturated with the most delicious rich malted garlic butter. Superb. I have had the Beef Bolognaise with both angel hair spaghetti and rigatoni and both have been very tasty indeed. I wouldn't say that the Bolognaise has the wow factor but it is a very pleasant acceptable main course. You do need to know that you have to ask for Parmesan cheese, it won't just be offered to you, but the staff will willingly bring out a very large shaker, if asked, with which you can liberally sprinkle fresh Parmesan cheese onto your meal. If I have any slight criticism at all, it is just that the salt is usually too damp to sprinkle over the food and the pepper pieces are too large to pass through the holes. However, that said, if you ask for the staff to bring you some salt and pepper in a small bowl they quickly do so and so you can still enjoy the usual condiments associated with pasta dishes. The ice cream Sundaes are wonderful there too. I forget the name and details but I think it was made of different berry ice cream and topped with a delicious sauce, something that tasted like butter toffee pop corn and sweet whipped sugar. I have eaten at PastaMania now on quite a few occasions and plan to definitely return there again and again.

a fast food place but nice for a change
Jan 2019 • Solo
I was wandering around the crescent mall in Quan 7 and decided to try this place for something different than my usual fare. I was pleasantly surprised, they have a set menu that changes daily with a noodle dish, an appetizer and a drink for 95,000 dong around $4.00usd, I had bacon aglio, cheesy garlic bread and a coke. I'm not sure how long this has been here, usually when I go to the mall I'm with my wife and daughters and they prefer something different. The waitstaff seem a little unsure of the menu, I was asked what type of pasta I wanted and I said spaghetti and a coke, the waitress had to ask again about the drink and when my meal came the pasta was rotini but other than a wrong order the meal was good and a good value at the price. They did have crushed red pepper and parmesan cheese with the meal, an item that a lot of pizza/ pasta places I've been to don't have.
